extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: American style caboose with cupola, 10.0 m over buffers, 3.1 m wide, 4.6 m high, standard gauge 1435 mm
extras.notes: front faces -Y, origin on the rail top (wheel contact plane); buffer and screw coupling axis 1.05 m above rail top (Cozy Trains kit standard, so it couples to the other wagons of the set); open end platforms with railings and corner steps; doors are part of the body; red emissive marker lanterns; bogies with wheelsets are part of the mesh (no moving parts); opaque tinted windows, no interior, no lettering

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
